<!-- Generated by .claude/sync_claude_rules.py from .cursor/rules/imported/cursor-rules/.cursor/rules/csharp-async-tasks.mdc; edit that file, then rerun. -->

Always return a Task or Task<T> from async C# methods. Do not return void.
When async void is required (e.g. event handlers, ICommand.Execute), wrap the entire body in try/catch and log all exceptions.
